tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rdzogs pa chen po bka' 'dus las: rtsa sgrub snying po don 'dus kyi: phrin las snying po gsal ba bzhugs:1$0000300

bka' 'dus rtsa ba'i snying tig go / ྈྈྈྈྈྈ bla ma he ru ka la 'dud: 1$0000250rdzogs pa chen po bka' 'dus kyi: rtsa sgrub snying po don 'dus kyi: phrin las snying po gsal bar bstan: 'jam dpal sku yi mtshams gcod ni:1$0000300 hūm̐: bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: snang srid 'khor lo rtsibs bcu 'bar: thugs las khro bo bcu 'phros pas: bdud dang bgegs rigs tshar bcad do: oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañja hūm̐ phaṭa: 1$0000250yang dag thugs kyi ting 'dzin ni:1$0000300 hūm̐: bdag nyid yang dag he ru ka: snod bcud ma lus ye shes kyi: dkyil 'khor rgya mtshor lhun gyis grub: kun kyang lha dang gzhal yas khang: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: 1$0000250zhi bas dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni:1$0000300 oṃ: spyi mgrin snying ga lte ba ru: 'jam dpal gar dbang gsang ba'i bdag: rdo rje 'chang rnams yongs su gsal: de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga sogs: gdan gsum tshang bas dbang bskur gyur: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu ā: 1$0000250rtsa ba khro bo'i 'dzab bzlas ni:1$0000300 hūm̐: he ru ka yi thugs ka ru: rin chen dpal be'u zur brgyad nang: ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka ru: rdo rje 'bar ba'i lte ba la: hūm̐ yig sngags kyi phreng ba bcas: phar 'phros sdig sgrib sbyong bar bskul: tshur 'dus dngos grub snod du rung: snod bcud 'dus pas dngos grub thob: a dang phaṭa kyi 'phro 'du yis: dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las mdzad: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭān ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: 1$0000250yon tan bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni:1$0000300 hūm̐: ban+dha'i nang du dam rdzas lnga: che mchog yab yum snyoms zhugs pas: 'khor 'das bcud 'dus bdud rtsir thim: byang chub sems kyi sprin chen pos: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes par bya: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa:

1$0000250ma mo rtsa rlung tshogs mchod ni:1$0000300 hūm̐: bla med he ru ka yab yum: gnyis med rol pa'i byang sems kyis: rtsa dang rlung dang thig le yi: he ru ka dang rnal 'byor ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dgyes: tshogs rdzas bdud rtsi lnga yi dngos: 'od zhu kha dog dri dang ro: phun tshogs 'dod yon dpag med kyis: ma mo bde chen rol pas mchod: oṃ gu h+ya dz+nyā na shrī he ru ka gu h+ya dz+nyā na kro dhī shā rī s+t+waṃ ma ma yo gi nī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: 1$0000250phur pa dgra dang bgegs la gdab:1$0000300 hūm̐: bdag nyid ma bcos rtsa ba'i lha: phur bu sras mchog kī la ya: phyogs bcu khro bo'i dmag dpung 'khrigs: 'gugs sgrol stob pa'i ging chen spros: gzung 'dzin dgra bgegs 'gugs 'ching myos: 'od gsal dbyings su bsgral ba yi: sha khrag srung ma'i zhal du bstab: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: 1$0000250lhag mas bka' sdod mchod cing rbad:1$0000300 hūm̐: phyag mtshan zhing chen g.yab mo yis: dpal gyi bka' sdod dmag tu sdus: bdud rtsi rak+ta'i pham phab gsol: dmigs pa'i steng du rbad cing btang: zhi rgyas dbang drag las rnams gyis: bcol pa'i las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra sarba yak+ṣa sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: 1$0000250dregs pa rnams la chad tho bsgrag:1$0000300 hūm̐: bdag ni dpal chen dregs pa 'dul: sde dpon sum cu bran du 'dus: gtor ma sha khrag bdud rtsi'i bcud: bzhes nas sngon gyi dam bca' bzhin: bstan srung phrin las myur du sgrubs: 1$0000250drag po sngags kyi zor 'phen pa:1$0000300 hūm̐: bdag ni stobs ldan nag po'i sku: dregs chen bco brgyad dgra la chos: phyag na gdug pa'i thun zor bsnams: mi mthun phyogs rnams tshar chod cig: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa: 1$0000250gzhan yang brtan ma skyong ba ni:1$0000300

hūm̐: slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng gi: spyan sngar khas blangs brtan ma'i tshogs: bshal chu'i bdud rtsi 'di gsol la: rnal 'byor dpon slob bod khams skyongs: ma ma hrīṃ hrīṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: 1$0000250dbang chen gsung gi rta bro brdung:1$0000300 hūm̐: rta yi brtul zhugs chen po ni: dbang chen rngam pa'i sgra sgrog cing: dpal gyi rta skad tse re re: rol pa'i rta bro chems se chem: bdud bzhi dgra gsum gsod pa'i bro: rdzogs pa chen po'i klong du brdung: oṃ pad+mān+ta krita badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa: 1$0000250rig 'dzin bla ma'i dbang bskur ba:1$0000300 oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'og min zhing du bde bar gshegs pa dngos: bde byed brtsegs nas zab mo'i gter kha 'byed: dur khrod brgyad du dngos grub rnam gnyis thob: bsam yas mchims phur skal ldan smin par mdzad: sgrub gnas brgyad du bka' brgyad grub pa brnyes: gsang sngags grub pa brnyes pa'i rig 'dzin rnams: 'og min gnas nas 'dir gshegs byin gyis rlobs: bdag cag 'dir 'dus rnams la dbang mchog skur: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa: 1$0000250'chi med tshe yi dngos grub blang:1$0000300 hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bral ba: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i sku: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥyur+dz+nyā na tshe bh+rūm̐ hūm̐: 1$0000250de ltar las kyi rim pa rnams: man ngag dang bcas bsgrubs pa yis: dngos grub las rnams dus gcig 'grub: sa ma ya: rgya rgya: 1$0000300 sprul pa'i gter chen o rgyan mchog gyur bde chen gling pas mdo khams nam mkha' mdzod kyi lho phyogs g.yu 'bar brag nas spyan drangs pa'i shog ser glegs bam gyi ngos las/ phrin las 'gro 'dul dbang gi gnas mchog ri bo dbang zhu'i snying po zla gam dbang gi phug par gtan la phab pa'i yi ge pa ni pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// /
